frases: Your gutter is secretly flooding your basement!
Right now. And you can't even see it.
The downspout drops all that rain right next to your house.
But the soil soaks it up like a sponge.
The water pushes on the wall, and sneaks through the tiniest crack.
And your basement becomes a swimming pool!
Add an extension, and send the water six to ten feet away.
Then slope the ground away from the house, about six inches over ten feet.
Now the rain goes anywhere but your basement.
Same house. Same rain. Dry socks!
Does your downspout dump at the wall? Tell Norm in the comments!
